title: A Basis for the 2-Kernel of Euler's Totient
subject: Erdős #249
question: What is the exact rank of the totient kernel at every integer base, which parts are formalised, and why does Erdős #249 remain open?
precis: For every integer base k≥2, including composite bases, the totient kernel through level e≥1 has an explicit rational basis of size k^e + 1; level 0 has dimension 1. The paper gives an ordinary proof using arithmetic independence. Lean also proves all-base canonical-family independence and the complete rank unconditionally by CRT and Dirichlet. These coefficient-space results do not decide irrationality. A 240-bit Farey window excludes every reduced denominator through 79,639,646,646,701,375,323,355,774,875,831,053, and exact diagonal certificates exist for every t through 82. No t = 83 certificate or cofinal certificate supply is proved; Erdős #249 remains open.
owns: problem-specific mathematical exposition for Erdős #249: the all-base exact finite-level rank and its formalisation boundary, infinite-dimensionality consequence, denominator exclusion, method limits, and open edge
not_authority_for: the validity of claims tagged Lean, which belongs to the cited kernel-checked source, or a solution to Erdős #249, which remains open
